name: Capture Declaration
description: The system shall capture declarations for normal, late, and delayed registrations for vital events (birth, death, marriage and divorce).

name: Generate Declaration ID
description: The system shall generate a unique Declaration ID for each declaration record.

name: Attach Evidence
description: The system shall allow attaching or referencing supporting documents and attestations.

name: Declaration-to-Registration Linkage
description: The system shall support linkage between a declaration and the subsequent registration record.

name: Support Multiple Channels
description: The system shall support multiple declaration models (facility-assisted, community, self-service portal, consular).

name: Notification Retrieval
description: The system shall retrieve notification information using a notification number where available.

name: Validation
description: The system shall validate mandatory fields and logical consistency before accepting a declaration.

name: Acknowledge Submission
description: The system shall issue an acknowledgement slip, SMS, email, or tracking receipt to the declarant.

name: Audit Trail
description: The system shall maintain an audit trail for the user, channel, time of submission, and any subsequent edits or escalations.

name: Deduplication
description: The system shall automatically detect and alert users to duplicate records and provide options for merging, invalidating, or dismissing records.

name: Create Legal Record
description: The system shall create the official legal civil registration record after declaration review and verification.

name: Generate Registration ID
description: The system shall generate a unique Registration ID for the official record linking it to the declaration ID.

name: Assign or Link UIN
description: The system shall link to the UID issuing authority and request the issuance of a new UID for a birth, update the UID on marriage registration, if needed, and retire the UID on death registration.

name: Maintain Registrar History
description: The system shall maintain the registrar's approval history, including endorsement details, timestamps, and office codes.

name: Enforce Non-Deletion
description: The system shall enforce that registration records cannot be deleted; they may only be amended through an authorized process.

name: Registrar Authorization
description: The system shall ensure that only an authorized or delegated registrar may complete a registration.

name: Form Completion
description: The system shall allow authorized users to verify the completeness of declaration forms and complete them when information is incomplete or missing.

name: Prompts and Alerts
description: The system shall provide prompts and alerts according to configured protocol.

name: Suspension and Cancellation
description: The system shall allow suspension or cancellation of a registration record if proven and authorized by the competent authority that registration was done in a fraudalent manner or by furnishing wrong information.

name: Generate Certificate
description: The system shall generate digital or physical certificates derived from finalized registration records.

name: Support Certificate Types
description: The system shall support multi-formatted and multilingual certificate models.

name: Anti-Fraud Controls
description: The system shall include anti-fraud controls on certificates (e.g., QR codes, serial numbers, digital signatures). QR code should be digitally signed or verifiable as a lot of countries print QR code with plain text.

name: Manage Issuance & Reprints
description: The system shall support first certificate issuance, additional copies, and reprints, including payment and delivery options.

name: Verification Features
description: The system shall provide verification features for certificates, such as QR code lookup or serial number validation.

name: Audit Issuance
description: The system shall log issuance, reprint count, delivery status, and receipt acknowledgement.

name: Internal Submission and Approval
description: The system shall allow internal processes for certificate submission and approvals.

name: Print Forms and Certificates
description: The system shall allow authorized users, including clients, to print certificates.

name: Support Amendment Requests
description: The system shall support amendment and correction requests, including administrative and substantive changes.

name: Approval Workflows
description: The system shall provide configurable approval workflows for different types of corrections (clerical vs. judicial).

name: Maintain Version History
description: The system shall preserve original values and maintain a versioned audit trail of all changes.

name: Revise Certificate Issuance
description: The system shall issue a revised certificate upon approval of an amendment and flag superseded versions.

name: Downstream Notification
description: The system shall notify integrated downstream systems (e.g., National ID) of approved changes.

name: Send Status Messages
description: The system shall send case-status messages to clients and authorized stakeholders (e.g., notification, declaration, registration stages).

name: Maintain Delivery Logs
description: The system shall maintain delivery logs, including message ID, gateway response, delivery status, timestamps, and retries.

name: Support Follow-up Actions
description: The system shall support follow-up actions for missing information, appointment coordination, and failed deliveries.

name: Privacy Protection
description: The system shall ensure sensitive personal data is not sent through insecure channels and use reference numbers instead.

name: Maintain Reference Data
description: The system shall maintain authoritative master data for locations, facilities, offices, users, registrars, devices (at least core devices), and reference values.

name: Manage Unique Identifiers
description: The system shall manage unique identifiers and coding schemes across the CRVS ecosystem.

name: Preserve Historical Mappings
description: The system shall preserve historical mappings and effective dates for administrative boundary or facility changes.

name: Audit Master Data Changes
description: The system shall ensure all master data and identifier changes are traceable and auditable.

name: Calculate Fees
description: The system shall calculate applicable fees based on service type, applicant category, urgency, and penalties for late and delayed registration.

name: Validate Payments
description: The system shall validate payments made via various channels (mobile money, cash, online gateway).

name: Issue Receipts
description: The system shall issue a receipt (paper or digital) for every accepted payment.

name: Support Reconciliation
description: The system shall support reconciliation of transactions by channel, cashier, date, and purpose.

name: Handle Waivers/Discounts
description: The system shall support approved exemptions, waivers, and discounts with authorization and audit logging.

name: Payment Exceptions
description: The system shall support controlled exception workflows for duplicate payments, failed payments, refunds, and chargebacks.

name: Generate Statistical Outputs
description: The system shall generate statistical tables, indicators, dashboards, and exports from validated registration data.

name: Adhere to Standards
description: The system shall align vital statistics outputs with UN principles/recommendations and national standards.

name: Anonymize Data
description: The system shall mask, remove, or suppress personally identifiable information (PII) in statistical outputs.

name: Apply Disclosure Control
description: The system shall store extraction date, cut-off date, reference period, code-list version, inclusion rules, publication version, confidentiality flags, reviewer/approver details, and distribution log.

name: Store Publication Metadata
description: The system shall support data quality checks for completeness, consistency, duplicate impacts, outliers, age-heaping, coding issues, and other agreed indicators.

name: Data Quality Checks
description: The system shall enable capture, update, and processing of a declaration using devices without internet connectivity.

name: Secure Local Storage
description: The system shall encrypt offline data at rest on the device and make it accessible only to authorized users.

name: Data Synchronization
description: The system shall synchronize offline records with the central CRVS database once connectivity is restored.

name: Conflict Resolution
description: The system shall apply duplicate detection and conflict resolution when records are uploaded from offline devices.

name: Audit Traceability
description: The system shall maintain an audit trail from device capture to central synchronization (device ID, user ID, timestamps).

name: Offline Authentication
description: The system shall support secure offline authentication using cached credentials or another approved mechanism.

name: Offline Identifier Reconciliation
description: The system shall reconcile temporary or preallocated offline identifiers with official central identifiers after synchronization.

name: Provide Verification Service
description: The system shall provide a secure service to verify civil registration certificates and underlying event records through a verifiable credentials platform (if available) – the CRVS system should not try to re-create such a platform.

name: Support Multiple Channels
description: The system shall support multiple verification channels: online portal, QR/barcode scan, API, and offline verification.

name: Enforce Access Control
description: The system shall enforce differentiated access levels (public vs. restricted) based on legal frameworks and user credentials.

name: Maintain Audit Log
description: The system shall maintain a complete audit trail of all verification attempts, including user, channel, and timestamp.

name: Differentiated Verification Responses
description: The system shall support differentiated verification responses, ranging from yes/no confirmation to full legal verification according to user authorization and legal rules.

name: Detect Duplicates
description: The system shall detect and prevent duplicate registrations using scheduled or event-based matching algorithms.

name: Provide Resolution Workflow
description: The system shall provide a workflow for resolving data conflicts and potential duplicate records (merge, false positive, invalidate).

name: Enforce Uniqueness
description: The system shall ensure that each vital event and each individual has a unique identifier (e.g., Unique ID/PIN).

name: Archive Original Records
description: The system shall archive original records when merged or invalidated, never physically deleting them from the database.

name: Configure Matching Rules
description: The system shall allow administrators to configure matching thresholds, matching rules, blocking parameters, and review queues.

name: Side-by-Side Duplicate Review
description: The system shall display potential duplicate records side by side with matching information highlighted for registrar review.

name: Support Configurable Workflows
description: The system shall support configurable workflows for different event types (birth, death, marriage).

name: Role-based Task Assignment
description: The system shall provide role-based task assignments and work queues (e.g., clerk, registrar, supervisor).

name: Generate Unique Registration Number
description: The system shall generate a unique registration number upon final approval of a case.

name: Send Status Notifications
description: The system shall  send status notifications to informants at critical stages (submission, approval, rejection).

name: Enforce State Transitions
description: The system shall enforce that state transitions follow configured workflow paths and user roles.

name: Monitor SLA & Escalate
description: The system shall monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and automatically escalate breached or at-risk cases.

name: Immutable Status History
description: The system shall maintain immutable status history for each case, including old state, new state, actor, timestamp, and comments.

name: Authorized Case Reassignment
description: The system shall support authorized reassignment of cases with reason capture and audit logging.

name: Support Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
description: The system shall support role-based access control (RBAC) for all functions.

name: Enforce Strong Password Policies
description: The system shall enforce strong password policies (minimum length, complexity, expiry).

name: Provide Audit Trail
description: The system shall provide an audit trail of all user management activities (create, update, disable, delete).

name: Allow Administrator Management
description: The system shall allow administrators to manage user accounts (create, read, update, disable, delete).

name: Geographic Scope Assignment
description: The system shall support geographic scope assignment for users to restrict data access by jurisdiction.

name: Terminate Disabled User Sessions
description: The system shall terminate active sessions immediately when a user account is disabled.

name: Periodic User Access Review
description: The system shall support periodic review of active users and assigned roles.

name: Task Management
description: The system shall allow task management features for users, such as grouping applications by completion or pending status.

name: Local Office Process Support
description: The system shall support local registration office processes, including entry of forms, approval management, and identification of gaps.

name: Provide Public Web Portal
description: The system shall provide a public web portal for public services.

name: Online Application Submission
description: The portal shall allow users to submit registration applications online.

name: Application Tracking
description: The portal shall allow users to track the status of their applications.

name: Online Appointment Scheduling
description: The portal shall provide an online appointment scheduling system.

name: Automated Reminders
description: The system shall send automated reminders for upcoming appointments via SMS/email.

name: Secure Account Creation
description: The portal shall support secure user account creation and verification using email or SMS OTP.

name: Document Upload
description: The portal shall allow users to upload supporting documents in accepted formats and within configured size limits.

name: Save and Resume Applications
description: The portal shall allow partially completed applications to be saved and resumed.

name: Appointment Check-in
description: The system shall support appointment check-in using a QR code or reference number and update appointment status.

name: Support Bulk Import
description: The system shall support bulk import of historical data from external sources (databases, spreadsheets).

name: Interface for Manual Entry
description: The system shall provide an interface for manual entry of legacy paper records.

name: Maintain Audit Trail for Migration
description: The system shall maintain an audit trail of all migrated records, including source reference and timestamp.

name: Flag Legacy Records
description: The system shall allow legacy data to be included or excluded from statistical reports based on configuration.

name: Validate Migrated Data
description: The system shall validate migrated data against schema, mandatory-field, format, duplicate, and quality rules before final commit.

name: Migration Quarantine and Error Reports
description: The system shall quarantine records that fail migration validation and generate error and reconciliation reports.

name: Link Scanned Legacy Images
description: The system shall link scanned images or original source references to migrated legacy records.

name: Provide Predefined Reports
description: The system shall provide predefined statistical reports on births, deaths, marriages, and divorces.

name: Allow Ad-hoc Reports
description: The system shall allow authorized users to generate ad-hoc reports with customizable filters.

name: Support Standard Exports
description: The system shall support export of data in standard formats (CSV, SDMX) for integration with the National Statistics Office.

name: Display KPI Dashboards
description: The system shall maintain a dashboard displaying key performance indicators (KPIs) for registration coverage and timeliness.

name: Anonymize Public Outputs
description: The system shall anonymize personal data in any publicly accessible or externally shared statistical output.

name: Separate Reporting Layer
description: The system shall support a separate reporting layer, reporting database, or data warehouse to avoid degrading operational performance.

name: Report Reproducibility
description: The system shall store report parameters, query logic, scripts, or parameter sets used so that published outputs are reproducible.

name: Provide APIs for Data Exchange
description: The system shall provide APIs for real-time data exchange with health facilities, police, courts, ID systems, and other authorized systems.

name: Support Scheduled Batch Exports
description: The system shall support scheduled batch exports to the National Statistics Office in SDMX format.

name: Integrate with National ID
description: The system shall integrate with the National ID system for identity verification as well as updating it.

name: Support Document Scanners
description: The system shall support document scanners for uploading supporting documents.

name: Support Biometric Devices
description: The system shall support fingerprint readers for biometric capture of applicants where required.

name: Support Certificate Printers
description: The system shall support certificate printers for issuing secure documents.

name: Log All Data Sharing
description: The system shall log all data sharing and interoperability transactions.

name: External System Authentication
description: The system shall authenticate external systems and enforce authorization before any data exchange.

name: Data Sharing Governance
description: The system shall support data-sharing agreements, purpose limitation, consent checks where required, and approval workflows for sensitive extracts.

name: Integration Health Monitoring
description: The system shall monitor integration health and retry failed transactions according to configured rules before escalation.

name: Device Status and Error Logging
description: The system shall detect connected peripherals, display device status, log device errors, and support retry or escalation.

name: Maintain Secure Identity Registry
description: The system shall maintain a secure registry of all legal identities with lifecycle status (Active, Deceased, Inactive).

name: Provide Verification API
description: The system shall provide a secure API for authorized external agencies to verify legal identity.

name: Update Identity from Events
description: The system shall update the legal identity record upon marriage, divorce, name change, or other legal amendments.

name: Deactivate Identity on Death
description: The system shall deactivate (mark as "Deceased") the legal identity record upon death registration.

name: Support Temporary Deactivation
description: The system shall support temporary deactivation of a legal identity in cases of migration or identity theft reports.

name: Log All Identity Access
description: The system shall log all access to identity data for audit purposes.

name: Non-Reassignment of Legal Identity Identifier
description: The system shall ensure that a unique legal identity identifier is never reassigned to another individual, including after death.

name: Legal Identity Change History
description: The system shall retain a complete history of all legal identity changes, including previous names, statuses, supporting events, timestamps, and approving authority.

name: Prevent Second Active Identity
description: The system shall prevent creation of a second active identity until duplicate identity alerts are resolved.

name: Registration Transaction Response
description: The system shall process birth, death, marriage, divorce, adoption, and recognition registrations within ≤ 3 seconds under normal load.

name: Certificate Generation Response
description: Certificate generation shall be completed between 5- 30 seconds.

name: Search Response
description: Record search operations shall return results between 5 -30 seconds at district/national level queries.

name: Concurrent National Usage
description: The system shall support at least ≥ XXXX concurrent users nationally.

name: Concurrent Regional Usage
description: The system shall support at least XXXX concurrent users per region.

name: Concurrent District Usage
description: The system shall support at least ≥ XXX concurrent users per district.

name: Bulk Import Throughput
description: Bulk import shall support at least ≥ 1 million records per batch.

name: National Report Performance
description: National statistical reports shall generate within ≤ 60 seconds.

name: Performance Monitoring
description: The system must allow authorized users to monitor system availability and performance.

name: Scalable Architecture
description: The system shall support horizontal scaling and population growth over 20+ years without requiring system redesign.

name: Projected Transaction Volumes
description: The system technical design shall scale to support projected transaction volumes over time.

name: Efficient Resource Utilization
description: CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization shall remain within defined thresholds during normal and peak operations.

name: Secure Authentication
description: All users shall authenticate securely before accessing the system.

name: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: The system shall require multi-factor authentication for administrators, privileged users, and sensitive operations.

name: Least Privilege Access
description: The system shall enforce least-privilege access using role-based and jurisdiction-based access controls.

name: Session Timeout
description: The system shall terminate or lock inactive sessions after a configured time and require re-authentication.

name: Encryption in Transit and at Rest
description: The system shall enforce encryption of data at rest and in transit, including offline workstation data.

name: Secure Key Management
description: The system shall implement secure key management, including separation of encryption keys from data and regular key rotation.

name: Secure Password Storage
description: Passwords shall be stored using strong salted hashing and appropriate work factors; plain text password storage is prohibited.

name: Application Threat Protection
description: The system shall protect against SQL injection, cross-site scripting, cross-site request forgery, brute force attacks, and equivalent application threats.

name: Tamper-Proof Audit Logs
description: Audit logs shall be protected from modification or deletion, including by system administrators.

name: Hardening Standards
description: The solution shall apply recognized hardening standards such as CIS benchmarks or equivalent for infrastructure components.

name: Secure API Design
description: APIs shall follow security best practices, including authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging, quotas and throttling.

name: Supply Chain Security
description: The vendor shall demonstrate controls to manage hardware, software, open-source, and third-party dependency security risks across the product lifecycle.

name: Incident Monitoring
description: The system shall generate real-time alerts for failures, suspicious activities, and critical security events.

name: Consent Management
description: Individuals consent shall be recorded and enforced for data sharing with external agencies, including scope, purpose, duration, and revocation.

name: Data Minimization and Masking
description: The system shall apply data minimization, masking of sensitive information where appropriate, and anonymization of statistical exports.

name: Intuitive Interface
description: The system interface shall be easy and intuitive for users with different levels of computer-use experience.

name: Consistent Navigation
description: The interface shall provide consistent navigation, headings, menus, labels and controls across modules.

name: Contextual Help
description: The system shall provide contextual help, tooltips, examples, and clear task-oriented guidance.

name: Clear Error Messages
description: Error and warning messages shall be informative, user-friendly, and identify the issue as completely as possible.

name: Accessibility Standards
description: The system shall conform to applicable accessibility standards, including screen-reader support, keyboard-only operation, sufficient color contrast, and adjustable font size.

name: Multi-Language Support
description: The system shall provide multilingual support and enable easy language switching where applicable.

name: Local Formats and Structures
description: The system shall support local languages, local calendar systems where applicable, local naming conventions, and local administrative structures.

name: Responsive Interface
description: The user interface shall adapt to desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes.

name: User Learning Support
description: The system shall support product-based training and learning materials to reduce reliance on in-person training.

name: Annual Availability
description: The system availability shall be ≥ 99.5% uptime annually, unless a stricter national service level applies.

name: Critical Service Availability
description: Critical services including registration, certificate issuance, and verification shall be available 24/7 where required by the service model.

name: Maximum Downtime
description: The system must not exceed 12 hours downtime per year.

name: Online and Offline Operation
description: The system must allow users to work online and offline, with synchronization when connectivity is restored.

name: Automatic Failover
description: The system shall support automatic failover within ≤ 5 minutes.

name: Recovery Time Objective
description: The system shall recover from failures within RTO ≤ 4 hours.

name: Recovery Point Objective
description: The system shall maintain RPO ≤ 24 hours.

name: Transaction Integrity
description: The system shall ensure no data loss during transactions through ACID-compliant database transactions and automatic retry for failed operations.

name: Backup and Restore
description: The system shall provide automated backup and restore functionality, including regular full and incremental backups.

name: Offsite Disaster Recovery
description: The system shall maintain offsite backup storage and a disaster recovery site in a separate geographic location.

name: Backup Testing
description: Backups and disaster recovery procedures shall be tested regularly and documented.

name: Read-Only Final Records
description: Once finalized, civil registration records shall become read-only and may only be changed through authorized amendment processes with full audit trail.

name: Supervisor Approval for High-Risk Actions
description: High-risk actions such as merges, reversals, certificate voiding, and access to sensitive events shall require supervisor approval or enhanced controls.

name: Protection of Minors and Sensitive Events
description: Identity profiles for minors, foundling records, stillbirth/neonatal death events, and other sensitive events shall have additional privacy, access, and workflow protections.

name: Data Integrity Validation
description: All data entered shall be validated against defined business rules and referential integrity constraints.

name: Duplicate Prevention Before Finalization
description: Duplicate records shall be detected and prevented before finalization.

name: Chain of Custody
description: The system shall maintain chain of custody for physical documents, certificates, and critical certificate stock movements.

name: Error Reversal Controls
description: Erroneous actions shall be reversible only where legally permissible and with full audit trail and approval controls.

name: National Legal Compliance
description: The system shall comply with national civil registration laws, data protection and privacy laws, national archives laws, and statistical reporting requirements.

name: Legal Validity of Electronic Records
description: The system shall support legal validity and admissibility of electronic records, digital signatures, digital certificates, certified true copies, and audit trails where permitted by law.

name: International Standards Alignment
description: The system shall support alignment with UN Legal Identity Agenda, SDG Target 16.9, WHO standards for live birth/stillbirth/cause of death, and relevant interoperability standards such as HL7 FHIR where applicable.

name: Records Retention
description: Records shall be retained according to legal and archival requirements.

name: Statutory Deadlines
description: Registration deadlines and late/delayed registration rules shall be enforceable through configured business rules.

name: Audit and Oversight Access
description: Authorized auditors shall have read-only access to records and audit logs, with all auditor actions logged.

name: Regulatory Reporting
description: The system shall generate regulatory reports in prescribed formats and frequencies.

name: Citizen Access Rights
description: Citizens shall be able to access their own information as provided by law and subject to identity verification.

name: Modular Architecture
description: The system shall follow modular architecture with clear separation of concerns.

name: Externalized Configuration
description: Business rules and environment-specific settings shall be externalized and configurable without code changes where feasible.

name: Technical Documentation
description: Comprehensive technical documentation shall be maintained and updated with system changes.

name: Version Control
description: All code, configuration, and technical documentation shall be maintained in version control.

name: Automated Testing
description: The system shall support automated unit, integration, performance, and non-functional testing, with test coverage metrics tracked against defined targets.

name: CI/CD and Deployment Automation
description: The system shall support automated CI/CD pipelines, environment-consistent deployment, health checks, rollback capability, and zero- or minimal-downtime deployment.

name: Deployment Portability
description: The system shall support on-premises, cloud, and hybrid deployment, including containerization where appropriate and avoidance of vendor lock-in.

name: Device and Browser Support
description: The system shall support major browsers and desktop, laptop, tablet, and smartphone devices.

name: Open Standards
description: The system shall use open standards and standard data exchange formats, including APIs, JSON, XML, SDMX and other agreed formats.

name: Semantic Interoperability
description: The system shall exchange data with other systems while ensuring semantic interoperability through standard code lists, metadata and mapping rules.

name: Integration Health
description: Integration health shall be monitored with alerts, retry logic and escalation for persistent failures.

name: Reusable Shared Services
description: Common functionality shall be implemented as shared services and reusable components, with business rules documented centrally for reuse across modules.

name: Comprehensive Error Handling
description: All written software shall be subject to a comprehensive error-handling regime; errors and warnings shall be written to system logs and critical errors escalated.

name: Permanent Archiving
description: The system shall archive all documents, including legacy birth and death records, according to retention and archival requirements.

name: Monitoring Dashboard
description: The system shall provide real-time monitoring dashboards, performance monitoring, usage analytics, and alerts for failures or suspicious activities.

name: Incident and DR Testing
description: The system shall support documented incident response procedures, regular vulnerability scans, penetration testing, and annual testing of incident response and disaster recovery procedures.
